title: Brackets / Fittings / Connectors
description: L/T-shaped or irregular structural parts with mounting holes, weight reduction pockets, ribs
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 5 (Ti-6Al-4V) offers excellent mechanical properties and weight reduction (4.43g/cm3). Standard for aerospace brackets.
Form: CNC milled from plate is common for brackets. Flexible for small batches. Die forging for high volume.
comparisonNotes: Standards: AMS 4928 TC4 annealed plate, 100% dimensional inspection, anodized
